alex: Quick Q — we're thinking of adding a routing_hint to chat/completions responses to help smart routing. Is it safe for streaming clients? cc: @maria @ben

maria: short answer: unknown top-level fields should be ignored by clients, but streaming delta shape is pretty sensitive. need to be explicit.

ben: we discussed this briefly last week. if we put routing_hint inside choice.delta it could appear mid-stream which might confuse parsers. safer to attach routing metadata to the final response or under a dedicated meta field.

sophia: can you paste an example of what you want to emit? I want to run it against the SDK parser locally.

alex: sure — example (stream delta):
```json
{
  "id": "req_123",
  "type": "delta",
  "choices": [{
    "index": 0,
    "delta": { "content": "Hello ", "routing_hint": "low_cost" }
  }]
}
```

tanvi: hmm — that exact shape will break our streaming-sdk where we only expect text/role/func call fragments in delta. For backward compat we should avoid adding new keys inside delta. Proposal: add a `meta` object on the outer response or `choice.delta.meta` specifically documented to be optional and ignored by older SDKs.

ben: proposal A: response.meta.routing_hint (emitted only at final event). Proposal B: choice.delta.meta.routing (can be emitted early but parsers must ignore until final). I prefer A. less blast radius.

alex: i like A too — we mostly need routing once at decision time. Emitting at the final event avoids mid-stream surprises.

maria: can we write a compatibility rule in the contract: "clients MUST ignore unknown keys in delta events; servers SHOULD avoid adding new top-level delta keys without a deprecation window". That covers us.

ben: i'll open a PR with the contract text and add an integration test where an older client receives extra meta keys and continues to parse tokens. PR will include SDK tweak to preserve unknown keys in the model object for forward-compat.

deploy-bot: CI status: PR #4123 — draft opened by ben — build started.

pr-checker-bot: NOTE: streaming-parser test failing often on token boundary handling. Add test that streams partial UTF-8 boundaries.

sophia: tagging this for review — i'll take a look at the parser changes tomorrow morning. alex, ping me when PR is ready for review.

ben: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 (draft) — added spec note + tests for unknown fields + integration test against legacy-sdk.

alex: awesome. one last ask: update the changelog & contract page with explicit examples (both streaming and non-streaming) and a clear migration path: server-side flag `emit_routing_at_final=true` for initial rollout. i'll add the docs patch after PR merges.

maria: ack. also we should add a lint rule on the server side that prevents adding new delta keys without feature-flag approval. small ops detail.

ben: noted. I'll add the feature-flag and the lint.

sophia: LGTM pending minor test tweaks. will approve after CI stabilizes.

alex: thanks all — leaving this thread. If anything blocks review ping #oncall. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI: PR #4123 — tests passed ✅
